title: New template
description: Create a standalone template from the core starter kit.

blocks.text: new-template copies packages/core and scaffold into templates/<directory>/, merges Prisma, registers templates.json, and adds pnpm dev:<id>. This is the only time core is copied automatically.
Copy optional UI and features from packages/core/modules/ instead of hand-building Hero, Footer, SEO, etc. All module ids: enquiry-modal, footer, hero-simple, seo, gallery, reviews, legal-pages.

blocks.code:
pnpm new-template bakery bakery-website-template --name "Bakery" --modules enquiry-modal,footer,hero-simple,seo
pnpm template:add-module bakery gallery,reviews,legal-pages

blocks.title: --with-docs
blocks.text: pnpm new-template bakery --with-docs auto-creates docsite/content/templates-registry.json entry and docsite/content/developers/templates/<id>.json stub (patches docsite/src/lib/content.ts imports). Use when adding a template that should appear in the docsite generator.

items: Full Next.js tree with auth, leads API, storage, health, Docker, admin login
constants/site.ts stub with SITE.features flags (all false until modules installed)
Customize constants/site.ts (brand, SEO, theme, hero copy)
Add models to prisma/domain.prisma — run pnpm prisma db push
Create lib/features/<domain>/ or template modules under modules/<id>/
Add app/ pages, components, and app/api/<domain>/ routes
Add GETTING_STARTED.md, ARCHITECTURE.md for client developers
Register docsite: pnpm new-template <id> --with-docs (or add templates-registry.json + developers/templates/<id>.json manually)
Optional: template-modules.json + pnpm template:extract-modules / template:assemble for vertical slices

blocks.text: You do not need pnpm sync-templates after building a new template. Sync is only for propagating packages/core fixes into existing templates later.
new-template adds a manifest entry (directory, version, init.brandFields). sync-templates and tempjs list read directories from templates.json automatically.
